skip: The saved article has about 200 words of substance (its coinage section is empty) and adds little to the existing description. New in it: he was the brother of Vashishtiputra Satakarni; his reign is dated variously c. 152-181, c. 165-195, c. 170-199 or c. 174-203 CE; two inscriptions at Kanheri (caves 81 and 3) and one in Nasik cave 20, dated to his 7th year, recording the completion of the cave by the wife of a general named Bhavagopa; the Matsya Purana gives him 29 years. The article does not mention the ship coins or both coasts, which the existing description states.
